title: Component list
description: A list that pairs an id with a value: the platform list at data/platform.json, and the words one language shows for the component ids, under data/print/<lang>/card/component/. IDs are unique within a list and do not change when a value is corrected.

id.description: The stable identifier referenced by card or print data.

value.description: The value named by Wizards of the Coast.
